author: neal_illustrator
title: Hiring artists for comic and animation teams
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! I’m excited to see y’all’s portfolios! I’m so excited to have the team grow! I’m like a little studio now! Stay stellar!! Application Links are in my linktree (in bio)

author: truchargv
title: Looking for illustrators for content pool
content: We're looking for some incredible artists to join our Illustrator pool! Tap the link in bio to apply! Our illustrator pool is used for articles, newsletters, social media posts etc. Illustrators will be chosen and reached out to as needed.

author: smorgasburgmiami
title: Paid artwork for 2026 Grand Reopening
content: Calling all artists! Smorgasburg South Florida is looking for a creative mind to design the artwork for our 2026 Grand Reopening, and it could be YOU. The winning artist will receive $125 for their artwork, plus the opportunity to become one of our go-to creatives for major moments all season long, from Ube Fest and Chinese New Year to special events and more. To enter, you can either create your Grand Opening artwork and post it on Instagram tagging @Smorgasburgmiami , or submit through the link in bio. Deadline: September 10 Winner announced: September 15
